messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — the A/B run for feature flag `ui_v4` (planned ramp 50% -> 80%) is showing ~30% increase in p95 latency on the generation API for the canary slice. Also a small drop in reranker accept-rate. Can we pause the ramp and triage? @sahil @tj

sahil: seeing the spike in dashboards now. pulling logs for exp_2026_ui_v4_0423. which flag is driving the rollout?

maria: Flag name is `ff/ui_v4_ramp`. Experiment id is `exp_2026_ui_v4_0423`. Canary audience = `small_mobile_users` (~3k/day).

tj: Quick proposed checklist — 1) pause rollout 2) narrow canary to 1% 3) enable fallback model 4) capture traces + perf profile. I can take 1 and 2 now unless someone objects.

maria: please go ahead and pause. we want the smallest blast radius while we investigate.

sahil: to pause via CLI: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/flags/pause -d '{"flag":"ff/ui_v4_ramp"}'` — or use Console -> Flags -> ff/ui_v4_ramp -> Pause. I'll start pulling KV cache traces and kernel selection logs.

tj: done — paused at 2026-04-23T14:12Z. ops-bot:

ops-bot: flag ff/ui_v4_ramp set to 'paused' by tj at 2026-04-23T14:12Z. Current rollout -> 0%. :white_check_mark:

kelly: Before any resume, request we: a) move canary audience to `mobile_lowlatency` (smaller, diff perf profile), b) attach rollout policy to force `fallback_model: v2` for treatment, c) add early-stop rules: stop if p95_latency > baseline*1.2 for 30m OR error_rate_delta > 0.5% for 15m.

maria: agree. also capture ~200 sample prompts and traces for affected users. sahil can you diff model kernel selection / quantization path vs control? we saw a mismatch once before.

sahil: on it. starting sim to reproduce with same sequence lengths and batch mix. will attach logs here in ~15m. if sim reproduces, rollback model variant for canary to v1.

tj: for the experiment config I'll change treatment_pct -> 1% and add stop rules + fallback. updating exp config now: 

```json
{
  "experiment_id": "exp_2026_ui_v4_0423",
  "treatment_pct": 1,
  "stop_rules": [
    {"metric":"p95_latency","threshold":1.2,"window_mins":30},
    {"metric":"error_rate_delta","threshold":0.005,"window_mins":15}
  ],
  "fallback": "model:v2"
}
```

maria: timeline: try to stabilize and reproduce root cause within 2 hours. if unresolved, full rollback for the feature. everyone ok?

kelly: :thumbsup:

sahil: will update with initial logs and sim output in ~15m. tagging this thread so we can trace actions. :eyes:
